articles.title: How to book a table?
articles.content:
## How to Book a Table

1. Go to the booking page
2. Select date and time
3. Choose a table
4. Complete payment

You will receive a confirmation message after successful booking.

articles.title: How to reset password?
articles.content:
## Reset Password

1. Click 'Forgot Password' on the login page
2. Enter your email address
3. Check your email for the reset link
4. Click the link to set a new password
